summary.plain: The group of physicists who built and ran the CDMS II dark matter detector at the Soudan mine in Minnesota from the mid-2000s to 2009.
summary.technical: Collaboration operating the CDMS II cryogenic germanium/silicon dark matter search at the Soudan Underground Laboratory; continuous with the earlier CDMS programme and succeeded by the SuperCDMS collaboration.
